source: 631 Devilogy
target: 631 Devilologia

source: The steeple’s base was paved with black stone bricks, and a colossal pillar rose proudly.
target: Basis campanili lateribus lapideis nigris stratis aedificata erat, et columna ingens superbiter exsurgit.

source: Lumian felt like a visitor in a giant’s kingdom as he strode through the expansive and dimly lit space.
target: Lumian se hospitem in regno gigantis sensit, dum per spatium amplexum et vix illuminatum incedebat.

source: The occasional tall residents who effortlessly towered over him only heightened this impression.
target: Incolae interdum altissimi, qui eum facile superabant, hanc admirationem solum augebant.

source: Guided by the signs on the wall, he ascended to the third floor, revealing rows of imposing bookshelves.
target: Signis in pariete ductus, tertiam tabulatum ascendit, revelans ordines armariorum librariorum imponentium.

source: The custodian of the library, an elderly man draped in a linen robe, oversaw the space.
target: Custos bibliothecae, senex linteis indutus, spatium curabat.

source: Even seated, he matched Lumian’s height, and his slightly gray skin bore the marks of age.
target: Etiam sedens, altitudinem Lumiani aequabat, et cutis eius paulo cinerea vestigia aetatis portabat.

source: Engrossed in a goatskin-bound book, the library administrator paid no heed to Lumian’s entrance, his gaze firmly fixed on the text.
target: Immersus in libro corio caprino ligato, administrator bibliothecae adventum Lumiani non animadvertit, oculis ad scriptum constanter fixis.

source: Lumian, not rushing to seek permission for his exploration, entered the library and followed the guidelines posted on each row of bookshelves leading to the section housing mythical books.
target: Lumian, non festinans licentiam ad suam explorationem quaerere, bibliothecam intravit et regulas in quolibet ordine armariorum librariorum positas sequebatur, quae ad partem librorum mythicorum ducebant.

source: He ran his finger over the weathered leather-bound book and another with freshly copied pages, choosing a tome that chronicled creation myths.
target: Digitum per librum veterem corio ligatum et aliud cum paginis recens scriptis cucurrit, eligens volumen narrans mythos creationis.

source: Before the bookshelf, Lumian casually flipped through its pages, only to stuff the book back.
target: Ante armarium librariarium, Lumian paginis leviter pervolvit, deinde librum iterum reponit.

source: He couldn’t comprehend it!
target: Id intellegere non potuit!

source: The words were in Jotun!
target: Verba in Jotun erant!

source: This ancient language, associated with the Beyonder race of giants, possessed the ability to manipulate the forces of nature.
target: Haec antiqua lingua, cum genere Beyonder gigantum coniuncta, facultatem vires naturae manipulandi habebat.

source: Ranked alongside Dragonese, Elvish, and ancient Hermes, Jotun held significant importance in mysticism.
target: Comparatus cum lingua Dragonese, Elvish, et antiquo Hermete, Jotun in mysticis momentum magnum habebat.

source: Although Lumian had mastered ancient Hermes and Hermes, Jotun remained a language he recognized but hadn’t fully mastered.
target: Quamquam Lumian antiquam Hermetam adeptus erat, Jotun tamen lingua erat quam agnoverat sed plene non didicerat.

source: He could barely decipher the title of the ancient book but couldn’t comprehend its contents.
target: Titulum libri antiqui vix perscrutari potuit, sed eius contenta intellegere non potuit.

source: A sweep of his gaze revealed a corresponding copy of the ancient book, this time written in ancient Feysac—a human language devoid of supernatural influence.
target: Oculus eius, intuens, deprehendit exemplar congruum libri antiqui, hoc tempore in antiqua Feysac scriptum—lingua humana sine vi supernaturali.

source: Joy surged within Lumian as he retrieved the soft-covered book and settled into the reading area near the window.
target: Gaudium in Luminio effluit, cum librum tegumentum molli habentem recepisset et in area lectionis prope fenestram consedit.

source: Throughout the entire process, no one intervened or issued a warning.
target: Per totum processum, nemo intervenit nec monitionem edidit.

source: <nulli>This library is entirely open to everyone. Even those not residing in the New City of Silver can peruse its contents, but borrowing seems to be off the table? Or perhaps, the knowledge on this level isn’t deemed confidential, Lumian mused, maintaining a steady pace.
target: <nulli>Haec bibliotheca omnibus penitus aperta est. Etiam qui in Nova Urbe Argentea non habitant, eius contenta perlegi possunt, sed usus librorum videntur excludi? Vel fortasse, scientia in hoc gradu non censetur secreta, meditatusque Lumian constanter procedebat.

source: He strolled past the section dedicated to Beyonder creatures, and his keen eyes snagged a book titled “Devilology.”
target: Ambulans praeter partem creaturarum Beyonder dedicatam, oculi eius acuti librum titulatam “Devilology” deprehenderunt.

source: <nulli>Devilology… Recalling recent encounters, Lumian snagged the corresponding copy.
target: <nulli>Devilology… Meminens recentes occursus, Lumian exemplar congruum rapuit.

source: In the reading area, he chose a spot shielded from direct sunlight yet bathed in ample illumination. Seated, he delved into the pages of “Devilology.”
target: In area lectoria, locum elegit, qui a radicibus solis directis tutus sed luce opima illustratus esset; sedens, paginas “Devilologiae” perlustrare coepit.

source: As he read, Lumian’s eyes widened, and his mouth hung slightly ajar.
target: Dum legebat, oculi Lumiani dilatabantur, et os eius leviter apertum remainerat.

source: He murmured to himself, <nulli>Is it really acceptable to have this kind of knowledge available to the public?
target: Murmuravit ad se, <nulli>Num re vera licitum sit talem scientiam populo praesto habere?

source: Each piece of information was invaluable!
target: Singula notitia inestimabilia erant!

source: The “Devilology” book meticulously outlined the traits and behaviors of creatures from various species after transforming into Devils.
target: Liber “Devilologiae” diligenter describebat notas et mores creaturarum ex variis speciebus, postquam in Diabolos transformatae erant.

source: It also provided detailed analyses of Devils with distinct personalities within the same species.
target: Praeterea praebebat analysim accuratam Diabolorum cum personalitatibus distinctis intra eandem speciem.

source: For those potentially facing Beyonders of the Devil pathway in combat, the value of this book rivaled that of a potent Grade 2 Sealed Artifact or its corresponding mystical item.
target: Pro iis qui fortasse in pugna contra viam Diabolicam Beyonder contendunt, pretium huius libri aequipollens erat potentissimo Artefacto Sealed Gradus II aut eius mystico simili.

source: <nulli>Moreover, how did the New City of Silver come by such knowledge?
target: <nulli>Praeterea, quomodo Nova Urbs Argentea talem scientiam adeptus est?

source: It’s improbable they could compile creature illustrations without dispatching hundreds of Devils…
target: Improbabile est ut imagines creaturarum congregare possent sine mittendo centena Diaboli…

source: Could it be that the half-giants and giants here are Devil Hunters?
target: Num hic semigiantes et gigantes Diaboli venatores sint?

source: Perhaps, in ancient times, when Devils were more active, they shared information with other factions?
target: Fortasse, temporibus antiquis, cum Diaboli magis activos essent, notitias cum aliis factionibus communicabant?

source: Lumian grew more alarmed as he read on.
target: Lumian magis consternatus est dum perlegebat.

source: Midway through, he massaged his throbbing temples, sensing a rapid depletion of his spirituality.
target: In media parte, templa pulsantia massavit, sentiens rapidum spiritualitatis decrementum.

source: Lumian temporarily closed “Devilology,” intending to explore the creation myths of the New City of Silver and take a well-deserved break.
target: Lumian, temporarie “Devilologiam” clausit, intendens mythos creationis Novi Urbis Argenteae explorare et requiem meritam capere.

source: From the very outset, the creation myth read:
target: Ab initio, mythus creationis legebatur:

source: “The omnipotent and omniscient god created everything before slipping into a profound slumber.
target: “Deus omnipotens et omniscient, omnia creavit, antequam in profundum soporem incidisset.

source: “Among the mythical races He brought into being, Giant King Aurmir, Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt, Elf King Soniathrym, Vampire Ancestor Lilith, Devil King Farbauti, Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace, Mutant King Kvastir, and King of Demonic Wolves Flegrea emerged as potent and crazy beings. They partitioned the authority left by the Lord, transforming into ancient deities governing the sky, land, sea, reality, the spirit world, and the astral realm…”
target: “Inter gentes mythicas quas ille creavit, exstiterunt: Rex Gigantum Aurmir, Draco Imaginationis Ankewelt, Rex Elforum Soniathrym, Antecessor Vampirorum Lilith, Rex Diabolicus Farbauti, Antecessor Phoenicis Gregrace, Rex Mutatus Kvastir, et Rex Luporum Daemoniacorum Flegrea, qui erant simul potentes ac insanissimi. Diviserunt auctoritatem a Domino relicta, transformantes se in deos antiquos, qui caelum, terram, mare, realitatem, mundum spirituum atque regnum astrale gubernabant…”

source: Abruptly, a dull-skinned, slightly gray finger tapped a specific spot on the page.
target: Subito, digitus cutis opacae et paulo cinerea in loco certo paginae pulsavit.

source: An aged, raspy voice echoed.
target: Vox senilis ac rauca resonavit.

source: “Do not utter this name in any Beyonder language.”
target: “Noli hoc nomen in qualibet lingua Beyonder pronuntiare.”

source: Lumian looked up, surprised to find the library administrator, previously immersed in his books, standing beside him seemingly out of nowhere.
target: Lumian oculos extulit, miratus ut administrator bibliothecae, antea in libris immersus, iuxta se stans quasi ex nihilo apparuisset.

source: As a Hunter, Lumian remained oblivious!
target: Ut venator, Lumian manebat inscius!

source: Partly due to the lingering dizziness from reading “Devilology,” it showcased the library administrator’s proficiency in concealing both breath and movement, given his towering stature of more than three meters.
target: Partim ob vertiginem manentem ex lectione “Devilologiae”, id ostendit peritiam administratoris bibliothecae in celando tam spiritum quam motum, propter staturam eius imponentem, plus quam tribus metris.

source: Lumian redirected his attention to the name indicated by the library administrator.
target: Lumian animadvertit ad nomen ab administrator bibliothecae indicatum.

source: “Devil Monarch Farbauti.”
target: “Rex Diabolicus Farbauti.”

source: Without awaiting Lumian’s inquiry, the library administrator, bearing giant-like traits, shifted his finger a few centimeters and remarked, “It’s advisable to avoid pronouncing this name in any Beyonder language as well.”
target: Sine exspectando quaestionem Lumiani, administrator bibliothecae, cum indolis gigantum similis, digitum paucos centimetra commovens inquit, “Optimum est hoc nomen in qualibet lingua Beyonder non pronuntiare.”

source: Lumian followed the motion of the finger, silently noting the corresponding name in his mind.
target: Lumian motum digiti secutus, silentiter nomen congruum in mente sua notavit.

source: “Vampire Ancestor Lilith.”
target: “Antecessor Vampirorum Lilith.”

source: “Why am I not allowed to read about it?” Lumian expressed his ignorance without reservation.
target: “Cur mihi non licet de hoc legere?” inquit Lumian, ignorantiam suam sine reservatione exprimens.

source: The library administrator spoke in a deep voice, “The Devil Monarch is still alive. This formidable ancient deity remains among the living.
target: Administrator bibliothecae voce profunda locutus est, “Rex Diabolicus adhuc vivit. Hic formidolosus deus antiquus inter vivos manet.

source: “And the Vampire Ancestor is suspected to be alive as well. In recent times, an individual in the city experienced disturbances after uttering the name ‘Lilith’ in Jotun. Although their life wasn’t at risk, they endured prolonged suffering.”
target: “Et Antecessor Vampirorum etiam suspicatur vivus esse. Nuper, aliquis in urbe perturbationes passa est postquam nomen ‘Lilith’ in Jotun edixit; quamquam vita eius in discrimine non fuit, longum dolorem passus est.”

source: <nulli>Ancient deities? Entities that once governed the world before the Ancient Sun God’s era? Lumian recalled fragments of his limited knowledge and inquired thoughtfully, “Did the Ancient Sun God rescue humanity from the dominion of these ancient deities?”
target: <nulli>Dei antiqui? Entia quae olim mundum ante aetatem Antiqui Dei Solis rexerunt? Lumian fragmenta scientiae suae limitatae rememoravit et quaesivit, “Num Antiquus Deus Solis humanitatem a dominio horum deorum antiqui liberavit?”

source: The library administrator, towering at more than three meters, turned to the last page and pointed.
target: Administrator bibliothecae, qui plus quam tribus metris altus erat, ad ultimam paginam vertit et digitum indicavit.

source: Lumian read the description:
target: Lumian descriptionem legit:

source: “The omnipotent and omniscient god stirred from slumber, rising from the earth to vanquish the ancient deities and reclaim His authorities.
target: “Deus omnipotens et omniscient, ex sopore evigilatus, ex terra surrexit ut deos antiquos superaret et potestates suas redimiret.

source: “Note: In the present era, the omnipotent and omniscient god is also known as the Ancient Sun God…”
target: “Nota: In aetate praesentis, deus omnipotens et omniscient quoque notus est ut Antiquus Deus Solis…”

source: <nulli>Indeed… Among the eight ancient deities, Devil Monarch Farbauti is still alive, Vampire Ancestor Lilith is suspected to be alive, and the rest have perished?
target: <nulli>Revera… Inter octo deos antiquos, Rex Diabolicus Farbauti adhuc vivit, Antecessor Vampirorum Lilith etiam suspicatur vivus esse, et reliqui perierunt?

source: Giant King Aurmir… Why does that name sound familiar?
target: Rex Gigantum Aurmir… Cur hoc nomen mihi notum videtur?

source: Ah, the provincial capital renowned for its red wine and champagne.
target: Ah, caput provinciae, praeclarum vinum rubrum et spumantem habens!

source: What ties does it share with the Giant King?
target: Quae nexus cum Rege Gigantum coniunguntur?

source: Lumian cautiously inquired, “Can these two names be pronounced in ordinary human language?”
target: Lumian cum cautela quaesivit, “Possuntne haec duo nomina in lingua humana communi pronuntiari?”

source: “The Vampire Ancestor’s is acceptable, but it’s advisable to refrain from attempting the Devil Monarch’s. You must exercise caution even in writing it,” responded the colossal library administrator.
target: “Nomen Antecessoris Vampirorum licitum est, sed optimum est nomen Rex Diabolicus non pronuntiare; etiam in scriptura cautela adhibenda est,” respondit administrator bibliothecae colossalis.

source: <nulli>Exercise caution even in writing…
target: <nulli>Cave etiam in scriptione…

source: Are all Demons like this?
target: Num omnes Daemones ita sunt?

source: Yes, the deity of the Devil pathway remains alive, an ancient being since the Second Epoch…
target: Ita, deus viæ Diabolicæ adhuc vivit, ens antiquus ex Secunda Aetate.

source: Lumian murmured, his heart stirred.
target: Lumian murmurat, et cor eius commotum est.

source: He retrieved a note with the Love Incantation from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Extraxit notam cum Incantatione Amoris ex sacculo viatoris sui.

source: “Have you encountered this name before? I came across a Demon who identified itself as this. Much like the others, it cannot be spoken or written, only thought.”
target: “Num antea hoc nomen tibi occurrit? Obviam Daemoni veni, qui se hoc nominavit. Similiter ceteris, neque dici neque scribi potest, sed tantum cogitari.”

source: The library administrator accepted the note with a hand capable of engulfing Lumian’s head. His gaze swept over the name “Naboredisley.”
target: Administrator bibliothecae notam accepit manu, qua caput Lumiani complecti posset; et oculi eius percurrerunt nomen “Naboredisley.”

source: He lapsed into deep contemplation. After a minute or two, he silently retrieved a copy from a concealed location within the bookshelf.
target: In altam meditationem cecidit. Post minuto vel duo, exemplar ex loco occulto intra armarium librariorum silentio extraxit.

source: The book’s title read: “A Summary of Rumors and Hearsay Before the Cataclysm (1)”
target: Titulus libri legebatur: “Compendium Rumorum et Fabulorum Ante Cataclysmum (1)”

source: <nulli>What a simple name… Lumian observed as the library administrator opened the newly-acquired book, pointing at a particular line of text.
target: <nulli>Quam simplex nomen… Lumian animadvertit, dum administrator bibliothecae librum nuper adeptum aperiebat et digitum ad lineam textus certam intendebat.

source: “As anticipated, it’s right here.”
target: “Ut exspectatum est, hic est.”

source: Lumian fixed his gaze and read silently.
target: Lumian oculos fixos tenuit et silentio legit.

source: “After the Devil Monarch Farbauti led the Devils back to the Abyss, occasional rumors persisted of Demons enticing humans.
target: “Postquam Rex Diabolicus Farbauti Diabolos ad Abyssum reduxit, rumores occasionales de daemonibus homines allicientibus perseveraverunt.

source: “The Demons operated under the following names:
target: “Daemones operabantur sub nominibus sequentibus:

source: “Beelbubli, Almos, Samael, Lilatan, and Naboredisley.
target: “Beelbubli, Almos, Samael, Lilatan, et Naboredisley.

source: “A high-ranking Demon Hunter speculated that these names conceal the aliases of Devil Monarch Farbauti…”
target: “Venator daemonum summi gradus coniectatus est has nomina alias Rex Diabolicus Farbauti celare…”

source: <nulli>The Devil Monarch Farbauti’s alias? Lumian felt a jolt as a thin layer of sweat coated his back.
target: <nulli>Alias Rex Diabolicus Farbauti? Lumian ictum sensit, cum tenuum stratum sudoris dorsum eius tegebat.

source: <nulli>Could Naboredisley be the Devil Monarch?
target: <nulli>Poteritne Naboredisley esse Rex Diabolicus?

source: <nulli>The sealed blood-colored Demon was the Devil Monarch?
target: <nulli>Daemon sanguineo colore sigillatus erat Rex Diabolicus?

source: <nulli>No, it doesn’t seem likely. If it were a genuine ancient deity, catching just a glimpse of His form wouldn’t have resulted in my eyes exploding in a dream. I would have lost control immediately… Yes, perhaps Farbauti’s pseudonym is among these names, but it doesn’t necessarily mean Naboredisley is Him… Lumian wiped his forehead with his right hand, forcing a smile as he addressed the library administrator, “As a foreigner, am I truly allowed to read these books? The knowledge they contain is exceedingly precious.”
target: <nulli>Non, verisimile non videtur. Si esset verus deus antiquus, solum eius formam intueri non fuisset causa, ut oculi mei in somnio explodescerent. Statim moderamen meum amissessem. Ita, fortasse pseudonymum Farbauti inter his nominibus est, sed non necesse significat Naboredisley eum esse. Lumian frontem manu dextra purgavit, subridetque fingens, et ad administrator bibliothecae locutus est: “Ut peregrinus, num vere mihi licetur hos libros legere? Scientia, quam continent, valde pretiosa est.”

source: The library administrator responded calmly, “The Chief has already informed us that you are Mr. Fool’s Blessed.”
target: Administrator bibliothecae respondit tranquille: “Praefectus iam nos certiorem fecit te esse Mr. Fool’s Blessed.”

source: “Very well.” Lumian found it amusing.
target: “Valde bene.” Lumian hoc risu delectavit.

source: Apparently, not every foreigner could access this library.
target: Apparet non omnes peregrini hanc bibliothecam accedere posse.

source: The library administrator offered no further warnings. He took the book chronicling pre-Cataclysm rumors and departed from Lumian’s vicinity.
target: Administrator bibliothecae nullas ulteriores monitiones edidit. Librum, qui rumores prae Cataclysmum chronicabat, accepit et a loco Lumiani discessit.

source: Lumian continued to alternate between reading “Devilology” and “Creation Tales,” taking breaks as needed.
target: Lumian inter legendum “Devilologiam” et “Fabulas Creationis” alternavit, intervalla capiens quando opus esset.

source: As evening approached, he barely concluded both books and departed from the Twin Towers.
target: Cum vesper appropinquavit, vix utrumque librum perfecit et a Geminis Turribus discessit.

source: Releasing his compressed spirituality, Lumian teleported back to the Berries in Port Hanth.
target: Dimittens spiritualitatem compressam, Lumian se ad Berries in Portu Hanth translatus est.

source: Surveying the still-bright sky, Lumian confirmed that the investigation into Hanth Island’s Demon legends had reached its conclusion.
target: Caelum adhuc refulgentem intuens, Lumian confirmavit investigationem de fabulis daemonum Insulae Hanth finitum esse.

source: The matter delved into complexities beyond his reach.
target: Res ad subtilitates extra eius potentiam pertinebat.

source: He no longer hesitated about his next steps and plans.
target: Non iam de suis propositis vacillabat.

source: Since he hadn’t fully digested the Conspirer potion, he resolved to head to West Balam and seek out Hisoka. There, he would hunt to digest the potion and complete the advancement ritual!
target: Cum nondum potum Conspiratoris plene absorverat, decrevit se versus Balam Occidentalem ire et Hisokam quaerere. Ibi venabitur ut potionem perdigeret et ritum progressionis perficeret!
